description: This Java class manages caching for vendor data using Infinispan. It implements a singleton pattern to provide a single instance of VendorCacheManager, which initializes an EmbeddedCacheManager with a specified configuration file.

classes.name: VendorCacheManager
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for initializing and providing access to an Infinispan cache manager for vendor-related caching operations.

methods.name: VendorCacheManager
methods.description: Private constructor that initializes the Infinispan cache manager using a configuration XML file.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static method that returns the singleton instance of VendorCacheManager, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: getManager
methods.description: Returns the EmbeddedCacheManager instance managed by this class.
